title: Halloween — The Last Corridor II (Optional Animation)

source_video.audio: AAC, stereo, 48 kHz; omitted from the wallpaper export
source_video.distribution: Local input retained unchanged; not included in the published asset set.
source_video.provenance: The repository owner confirmed that Grok generated this second animation of scene 13 and requested its addition. The exact model version, prompt and generation settings were not supplied.

content: Second supplied corridor animation: the figure moves toward the viewer, with spreading hair and changing facial expressions. Scene 14 is not used. This is an additional choice, not a replacement for halloween-jumpscare.webm.
loop: Playback restarts at the beginning; the last and first frames do not match. No seamless-loop claim.
producer: Grok animation generated and supplied by the repository owner; FFmpeg used only for the silent VP9 export.
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version n9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
production_command_note: The output argument is normalized to the published path; encoding ran in a temporary directory and the resulting file was copied unchanged.
changes: Encoded the supplied H.264 video as VP9 without resizing, cropping, retiming, interpolation, added transitions or upscaling. Omitted audio, attached cover art and source container metadata. The source MP4, first optional video, fourteen still wallpapers, application palette and desktop previews remain unchanged.

activation: Additional optional data asset outside backgrounds/. Not installed or enabled by a standard theme installation. Requires an Omarchy build with native OWE video wallpaper support and explicit installation and selection.
